findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed mops being stored with heads in the mop bucket and on the floor. The PIC inverted the mops during the inspection. Ensure that mops are always stored in a position that allows the head to air dry. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a portion of the wall above the reach-in freezer is exposed wood. Ensure this portion of the wall is sealed (i.e., painted) to make a smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable surface. The exposed wood must be sealed by the next routine inspection. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Upon entry to the facility, inspector used an infrared device on the Grab N’ Go cooler near the entrance to the facility. The device returned temperatures between 45 and 60 degrees on all of the foods in the cooler. Foods included RTE sandwiches, sausage sticks, cheese curds and other cheese products. A probe was used to collect temperatures on each area of the cooler. Temperatures were between 44 degrees and 53 degrees utilizing a probe thermometer. All items in the cooler except pickles were required to be refrigerated per labeling requirements. Foods have been in the cooler since being removed from a freezer at the start of the day. Foods are being voluntarily discarded by owner and an order of destruction has been completed which lists each item and weight which must be discarded through this process. The only foods in the cooler which are not required to be destroyed are pre-packaged pickles which do not require refrigeration. Repair/replacement of this cooler must be done before it can be used to hold food. Owner must contact SCDPH inspector prior to using cooler again.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
Flies were observed near the mop sink, an old pipe in the triple sink, and throughout the rear of the facility. The mop sink contains old soda equipment and water which is a harborage condition for insects. Clean the mop sink, remove the old pipe from the triple sink and reduce the number of flies in the facility. 

6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
Wiping cloths were observed under the soda boxes at the rear of the facility. Wiping cloths when not in use should be dry and clean or stored in sanitizer. The rags under the soda were soiled and appear to be used to catch dripping soda. Remove the rags or ensure they stay clean and dry by replacing them often. 

3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The shelving in the dry storage area of the facility still has areas of exposed wood. Owner is currently in the process of remodeling and will have the shelves painted. This is a repeat violation from the previous inspection. Ensure that the shelves are sealed and that they are smooth, non-absorbent and easily cleanable. 

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed the walk in food cooler to be holding milk and juice at 45F. These items were discarded as there is no log to determine how long they have been held at 45F.  The owner is calling his refrigerator repair person and will have them out tomorrow or as soon as possible. Owner states that the beer cave should be used for milk or perishable items until the other unit is repaired. 
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Observed that there is no thermometer in the sandwich cooler. Provide thermometer in the cooler. The thermometer in the walk in cooler is broken. There is an attached thermometer on the outside of the unit but recommend getting independent thermometers in the unit to monitor different areas. 
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: The sanitizer dispensing unit is not functioning properly. The facility also does not have test strips to properly prepare sanitizer solution. 4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.
